html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 28, 2022

On Jul 13, 2022, collaborative CRM vendor Weiling Tech (卫瓴科技) (founded 2020) closed a ¥100M Series A led by Yunjiu Capital, with Yunqi, Lightspeed China, and returning Sequoia China — 3rd round (angel Dec’20, Pre-A Sep’21). Stack centered on WeCom + WeChat: content, touchpoints, data close the B2B complex-sale loop from public ads → private-domain nurture → opportunity → order. 2022 product: marketing modules (ads, content, events, live) + full-cycle journey / lead-to-order. Major shareholder Shanghai Weiling LP 55.5%.

— END —
